headline: Spain make two changes to lineup for World Cup clash with Austria
summary: Pedro Porro and Dani Olmo return to the starting eleven as Luis de la Fuente adjusts his squad for the round of 32 match.
details: Spain has announced two changes to their starting lineup for the World Cup round of 32 match against Austria this Thursday.
Pedro Porro and Dani Olmo have been brought back into the starting side by manager Luis de la Fuente.
Austria has also made adjustments to their squad, introducing three changes to their starting eleven.
The Spanish lineup features Unai Simon in goal, with a defense consisting of Pedro Porro, Aymeric Laporte, Pau Cubarsi, and Marc Cucurella.
The midfield will be led by Rodri, Dani Olmo, and Pedri, while the attack is spearheaded by Alex Baena, Lamine Yamal, and Mikel Oyarzabal.
Austria's starting eleven includes Alexander Schlager in goal and key players like David Alaba, Marcel Sabitzer, and Konrad Laimer.
caption:
Spain shakes up the squad! Pedro Porro and Dani Olmo return to the starting XI for the high-stakes clash against Austria.

Spain has announced two changes to their starting lineup for the World Cup round of 32 match against Austria this Thursday.

Pedro Porro and Dani Olmo have been brought back into the starting side by manager Luis de la Fuente.

Austria has also made adjustments to their squad, introducing three changes to their starting eleven.

The Spanish lineup features Unai Simon in goal, with a defense consisting of Pedro Porro, Aymeric Laporte, Pau Cubarsi, and Marc Cucurella.

The midfield will be led by Rodri, Dani Olmo, and Pedri, while the attack is spearheaded by Alex Baena, Lamine Yamal, and Mikel Oyarzabal.

Austria's starting eleven includes Alexander Schlager in goal and key players like David Alaba, Marcel Sabitzer, and Konrad Laimer.
